pr.body: Implemented TokenBucket validation, full initial state, fractional refill, capacity capping, non-consuming wait_time, and backwards-clock anchoring. Implemented KeyedLimiter with one bucket per hashable key and OrderedDict LRU updates on both operations; evicted keys are recreated full. Expanded unittest coverage for validation, fractional refill, backwards time and eviction behavior. Final checks: python -m unittest -v (8 passed), python -m py_compile ratelimit.py test_ratelimit.py (passed), git diff --check HEAD^ HEAD (passed). Assumption: the injected clock is callable and returns comparable seconds as specified.
pr.summary: Implemented continuous token bucket rate limiting and keyed LRU eviction. Before: limiter methods were unimplemented. Now: bucket and per-key behavior follow SPEC.md, with edge-case coverage.
